description: This file defines a decorator class for CSS attribute validation within the HTMLPurifier library. The class allows disabling CSS properties for specific HTML elements by wrapping existing attribute definitions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_DenyElementDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that disables CSS properties for specific HTML elements during validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a definition to wrap and the element to deny.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the current token matches the denied element; if so, disables the property validation.
